long_biography.plain_text:
A real-estate deal in Albuquerque introduced David R. Grieve to SG Ellison, the future partner with whom he would build Diversified Restaurant Group. Their first restaurant investment supplied equity to former Taco Bell executives acquiring company-owned outlets. Convinced the model could scale, Grieve and Ellison left that partnership and formed their own franchise platform.

Beginning with a large Northern California acquisition, the group expanded across western and midwestern markets and added Arby's alongside Taco Bell. Grieve now serves as chairman while Ellison leads daily operations. Away from restaurants, Grieve became a Wetlands America Trust trustee and supported Ducks Unlimited's conservation priorities in the American West.
